narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Yes, you can always tell by looking at them, and the bigger one shows.
<bookmark mark='lay'/>Suppose the two angles measure eighty nine degrees and ninety one degrees.
<bookmark mark='alike'/>On the page they look almost exactly alike, and the eye is fooled.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>When angles are this close, looking is not a safe way to compare them.
